# description

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:description`](gmeow-description.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/description>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)

A free-text note or description about an entity — the unstructured NOTE field (a biography, a remark, an annotation). Genuinely flat: unlike names, dates or roles, a note has no structure to reify. Distinct from [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition), which documents ontology TERMS rather than instances. Language-tag the literal where applicable; non-functional.
